item.title: GitMorning 0.5.6
item.description:
GitMorning 0.5.6 — Your interests, trending streaks, and release alerts
- Interests: pick languages and keywords in Settings → Morning brief. Matching projects come first in the morning brief with a ★, and Today's Trending can show only them. - Trending streaks: projects on Today's Trending for two or more days in a row show 🔥 "N days", and project details show their rank for the last 7 days. - Release alerts: GitMorning checks your saved projects for new stable releases twice a day (nightly and beta builds skipped) and marks them in Saved. Notifications are optional. - Export Saved as Markdown: copy or save your saved projects, grouped by status with notes. - Security: tighter README preview and release checks. - Bundled Trending lists refreshed.
관심사 맞춤 아침 브리핑(★) · 연속 트렌딩 "N일째"와 최근 7일 순위 · 보관한 프로젝트 새 릴리스 알림 · 보관함 마크다운 내보내기 · 보안 보완
Apple Silicon · macOS 14+. This preview is not Apple-notarized yet; macOS may ask you to approve the first launch.
